name: infected-voices-mobile
description: Infected Voices Studio for Capacitor mobile, RedX browser hosting, and Windows

scripts.native:ios: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs ios
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.native:android: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs android
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
